name: myth2myth: Origin
detailed_description:
Welcome to myth2myth: Origin, where mythic heroes clash in epic, strategic battles! Forge magical puzzles and unleash the might of legends to defeat your rivals. Every victory earns you souls, wisdom, and mythic elements, unlocking incredible heroes—from humble warriors to rare myths only the boldest can claim!

Why myth2myth: Origin Stands Out?

  • Battles That Echo: Wield strategy and unique powers to triumph in fast-paced 3-minute showdowns.

  • Heroes Without Bounds: Collect Divinities, Creatures, Spirits, and more, all ready to rise in your ranks.

  • Victories That Reward: The more you win, the more souls, wisdom, and mythic elements you gather for new heroes.

  • Epic Evolution: Level up your heroes and evolve them to unleash legendary strength.

Forge an epic collection of mythological legends and lead them to glory! Your journey can be as vast as your dreams. Ready to carve your mythic legacy? Add to your wishlist and dive into this enchanted realm!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 550 Ti or AMD Radeon HD 6770 or Intel Iris Xe Graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 570 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
